posts.author: Seda
posts.body:
Hello all,
I am using RPG Maker MZ along side Visustella's plugins to make adjustments to the Shop Scene. I originally had an idea to use Items and Equips Core to change the background image of my Shop Scene whenever the user selects "Buy", and also to change it when they Select "Sell". After some trial and error and more careful reading, I realized I misunderstood the timing of the switches in the Shop Menu Settings.
With Visustella's plugins (or other compatible plugins), is there a way to change my background images the moment the player chooses the "Buy" or the "Sell" options?
If this is possible, then this could open up a whole new set of options and fun things I could do with my shop menus!
